filmIssues: The pull-back reads clearly and purposefully: the film opens tight on the slumped lifter, with the barbell partly obscured behind him, then draws back to reveal the untouched barbell, the empty platform and the vast stadium. That shrinking isolation directly expresses the setback described in the caption.
The lifter remains coherent throughout, with no visible tearing, doubled edges, halo or ghost of his original position. His contact with the bench remains believable despite the separate end scale.
No layer clips the frame edge awkwardly. The tighter opening crop is intentional and still retains the bench, platform and stadium context.
The first frame is a strong intimate opening; the final frame, holding the small lifter against the empty arena, is a good picture to dwell on while reading.
The dust ambient is subtle and compatible with the warm, aged 1950s offset-lithograph print style, which is preserved throughout.
